Tom H: hi team, onboarding hiccup day 1. my google account says 'access not provisioned' when i try to sign into gmail and drive. got the welcome email but can't finish setup. who should i ping?

Marie (IT): sorry about that, Tom. can you paste the exact message or a screenshot? is this on a personal device or company laptop? also did you accept the invite link in the welcome email (sometimes it expires after a few days).

Tom H: personal MacBook for now. message says: 'Your account has not been provisioned for Redwood. Contact your administrator.' i clicked the invite earlier today.

Nora (People Ops): i triggered the account at 09:10 so it should be active. Marie, can you check user status in G Suite? Tom, what's your okta username (email)?

Tom H: tom.h@redwood.ai (that's what was on the invite).

Marie (IT): checking... looks like the automated provisioning job didn't push the Drive license because the org unit was set to 'contractors' by mistake. i'm flipping it now. give it a minute then try signing out of all Google sessions and sign back in.

Ben (Infra): also make sure you're not already signed into a different Google account in Chrome. if you have multiple accounts the SSO redirect can pick the wrong one. quick test: open an incognito window and paste the workspace signin URL: https://accounts.google.com/AccountChooser?continue=https://mail.google.com

Tom H: tried incognito after ~5 mins, now it lets me into Gmail but i don't see the shared team drive or internal docs.

Marie (IT): that means the license applied but Drive membership needs to be added. Nora, do we want Tom in the "eng-dev" shared drive?

Nora (People Ops): yes add to eng-dev and the onboarding docs. also add him to the #eng Slack channel (i already invited in workspace).

Marie (IT): done. you should see the eng-dev drive in about 30s. Tom, one more thing: enable 2-step verification and register a security key if you have a YubiKey. we require either Okta Verify or a hardware key. here's the quick steps:
```
1) go to https://redwood.okta.com
2) Sign in with your google SSO
3) Profile -> Extra Verification -> Add Security Key
```

Tom H: i have a YubiKey. when i try to add it, Okta asks for 'webauthn not supported' on Safari. i can try Chrome.

Ben (Infra): Safari's WebAuthn support can be flaky with certain privacy settings. use Chrome or Firefox and ensure "Block third-party cookies" is off for the okta domain. if you still hit a wall, bring the YubiKey to the office and we can register via the wired port.

Tom H: registered on Chrome, okta shows MFA enrolled. one last thing: i still can't access the infra repo in GitHub. i got an invite but the repo is private.

Nora (People Ops): repo invites are handled by org admins. Ben, can you check GitHub team assignment? Tom, send your GitHub username in DM.

Tom H: username is tomh-dev. sent DM.

OnboardBot: Checklist update: Tom H completed "Google Workspace access" and "MFA enrollment" at 2026-03-24 09:44 UTC.

Ben (Infra): added you to the eng team on GitHub and the infra repo. you should have access now. try a git clone or check the invite link.

Tom H: cloning succeeded, can see infra repo, and i have access to eng docs. thanks everyone.

Marie (IT): welcome aboard, Tom! ping this thread if anything else pops up, or DM me for faster troubleshooting. :)
